title: Great option to see a lot in not much time
text: Illia was a great guide and we saw a lot in a short time!
author: Y1750MCcourtneyr

title: Great way to explore city centre
text:
Great way to explore city, took e-bike tour, cycling around Barcelona felt very safe, with pretty much entire route being on cycle lanes.

Tour goes around main attractions with guide giving a bit of history about each site, and allowing for a bit of a walk around the main ones 👍
author: Thomas_C

title: Very enjoyable and...
text: Very enjoyable and interesting bike tour. Covered a lot of the city stopping frequently to share information. Great guide and helped a lady who’s bike chain came off twice in the middle of the city!
author: Natasha_E

title: A can not miss experience
text: This was a FANTASTIC experience.  Our guide, Mariana (hopefully I got that right - the one with the chihuahua), gave us a lot of interesting information, took great care of us, and was just a delight.  Traveling around Barcelona on a e-bike was such an easy way to enjoy the sights and sounds of the city.
author: Elizabeth_P

title: 5 star recommendations
text: Excellent tour, took us all throughout Spain and our guide Ilya was very thorough in explaining the details of all the sites, and he was also funny and entertaining. I would recommend this tour! Wonderful activity that added to our trip to Spain.
author: Eric_B

title: Very pleasant and professional service.
text: Very nice and private tour. In just 1.5–2 hours, we got a great overview of Barcelona’s main sights. The service was professional and friendly, and the guide spoke clear and easy-to-understand English, which was perfect for non-native English speakers.
author: Marko_A

title: Must do!
text: Dania was a phenomenal tour guide. His knowledge of Spain is impressive! He is also very alert and positive about being in Spain.
author: James_A

title: Superb, from start to finish!!
text:
This was a brilliant experience, it is such a good way to see the sights of Barcelona.
Everyone at the hire place were so friendly and welcoming.
Marina our tour guide was just fantastic, her passion for the city just shone through as she took us around the various places, she really made our experience a wonderful one. I would definitely recommend doing this bike tour!!
5 stars all round. Thank you 🤩
author: Leanne_H

title: Great way to see the sights
text: Such a great way to see the sights of Barcelona. Our guide, Liuba, was very knowledgeable and friendly. Was one of the highlights our trip. Definitely recommend
author: Lisa_R

title: Fantastic bike tour of Barcelona
text: It was a lovely experience, seeing the biggest sights and getting all the history as well. We took the e bike option so it was a nice easy ride. And the bike lanes in Barcelona are great! Our guide, Alex, was knowledgeable and very nice.
author: Natalia_O
